properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Post-Auth Privilege Boundary Crossing on Edge/Management Appliances (low-priv -> admin within 10m)
properties.description:
Detects a single source IP + user-agent that, within a ~10 minute window, transitions from hitting a low-privilege authenticated endpoint (registration, onboard-customer, login, peering, auth API) to executing admin-only HTTP verbs (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) against admin paths (/admin*, /api/admin*, /configuration*, /vmanage*, authorized_keys, or the Grav-style data[access][admin]/data[groups] injection markers) on the same management plane. This is the joint TTP across this fortnight's wave of post-auth privilege-escalation flaws: CVE-2026-42613 (Grav Login plugin missing server-side validation of groups/access), CVE-2026-6973 (Ivanti EPMM remotely-authenticated admin RCE), CVE-2026-20127/20182 (Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller auth bypass — added to CISA KEV with confirmed in-the-wild exploitation), and GHSA-9h64-2846-7x7f (Axonflow multi-tenant isolation / access-control bypass). It spans the exploit phase between initial low-privilege authentication and the install phase (web shell drop, account creation, SSH key write); firing here catches the attacker before the persistence handoff. Will fire on the rapid low-priv->admin pivot pattern characteristic of these CVEs; will NOT fire when an admin session is preceded by an admin-tier authentication event from an allowlisted jump host, when only one stage is present, or on background management traffic that lacks the admin verb on a sensitive path.

Rationale: All four post-auth privilege-escalation vulns this fortnight (Grav data[groups] injection, Ivanti EPMM auth'd-to-admin, Cisco SD-WAN auth bypass, Axonflow tenant-isolation) share the same wire signature: a single client transitions from a low-privilege authenticated request to an admin-tier write within minutes. Detecting the temporal pivot — not any specific CVE's URL — survives IOC rotation and catches the un-patched variants likely to follow.
properties.query:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let LowPrivPatterns = dynamic(["user_register","/register","onboard-customer","/peering","/auth/login","/login.action","/api/v1/auth","/sessions/new"]);
let AdminPatterns   = dynamic(["/admin","/api/admin","data[access][admin]","data%5Baccess%5D%5Badmin%5D","data[groups]","data%5Bgroups%5D","/configuration","authorized_keys","/installer","/vmanage","/system/setting"]);
let IisEvents = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where csMethod in~ ("POST","PUT","PATCH","DELETE")
    | where scStatus < 400
    | extend full_request = strcat(csUriStem, iff(isnotempty(csUriQuery), strcat("?", csUriQuery), ""))
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SrcIp=cIP, UA=csUserAgent, Request=full_request, Method=csMethod, Status=scStatus;
let CefEvents = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RequestMethod in~ ("POST","PUT","PATCH","DELETE")
    | where isnotempty(RequestURL)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer=DeviceName, SrcIp=SourceIP, UA=RequestClientApplication, Request=RequestURL, Method=RequestMethod, Status=toint(EventOutcome);
union isfuzzy=true IisEvents, CefEvents
| extend stage = case(
    Request has_any (LowPrivPatterns), "low_priv",
    Request has_any (AdminPatterns),   "admin",
    "other")
| where stage in ("low_priv","admin")
| where isnotempty(SrcIp)
| order by SrcIp asc, UA asc, TimeGenerated asc
| serialize
| extend PrevStage=prev(stage), PrevTime=prev(TimeGenerated), PrevReq=prev(Request), PrevIp=prev(SrcIp), PrevUA=prev(UA)
| where stage == "admin" and PrevStage == "low_priv" and SrcIp == PrevIp and UA == PrevUA
| where datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, PrevTime) <= 10
| project AdminEventTime=TimeGenerated, LowPrivEventTime=PrevTime,
          DeltaMinutes=datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, PrevTime),
          Computer, SrcIp, UA, LowPrivRequest=PrevReq, AdminRequest=Request, Method, Status
| order by AdminEventTime desc
